metadata.title: Using convolutional neural networks to automatically score eight TIMSS 2019 graphical response items

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used IRT-based expected scores (IRT_theta) for data cleaning and sample assignment, which does not meet the criteria for using multiple plausible values with Rubin's rules.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that student weights were not used in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual student responses without employing multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed internal validation using hold-out samples and cross-validation, indicating that it did not validate findings on an external dataset.
